title: System construction and MD setup
action: Construct a zigzag carbon nanotube with 192 carbon atoms, length 23.96 Å and diameter 6.04 Å. Place a single radon atom (atomic radius 1.34 Å) inside the CNT. Assign standard Lennard-Jones force field parameters for C–C and Rn–C interactions (as per the literature referenced in the paper). Prepare LAMMPS input files with timestep 1 fs, NVE ensemble, initial temperature 300 K, rigid CNT, vacuum, no initial cooling.
description: Generate the initial atomic configuration and the LAMMPS input script for the production MD run.

title: MD production simulation
action: Run the classical MD simulation for 8000 ps with a 1 fs timestep using the prepared LAMMPS inputs. Record the instantaneous kinetic energy, potential energy, total energy, and temperature at every 1 ps. Save these raw time series to an intermediate CSV file (raw_energies.csv).
description: Execute the full production MD simulation and collect the raw energetic and thermal observables. This intermediate file is used by the next post‑processing step.

title: Thermodynamic property calculation and final output
action: Read the raw energies and temperature from step 2, then compute the derived quantities: molar specific heat, molar entropy variation, instantaneous efficiency (kinetic energy divided by total energy), and the ratio EKIN/TEMP. Write a single CSV file (simulation_results.csv) containing all raw and derived quantities as a function of time (one row per picosecond).
description: Assemble the complete time series of raw energies and temperature together with the derived thermodynamic properties, saving as a CSV with header. The file must contain 8000 rows (one per ps).
output_schema: Columns: time_ps (float), EKIN_kcal_per_mol (float), EPOT_kcal_per_mol (float), ETOT_kcal_per_mol (float), TEMP_K (float), molar_specific_heat_kcal_per_mol_K (float), molar_entropy_variation_kcal_per_mol_K (float), efficiency (float), EKIN_over_TEMP_kcal_per_mol_K (float). Header row. 8000 rows (one per ps).
